=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1184-1186 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The guard treats `resolver_status=resolved` as proof of explicit target-branch metadata, although PR-head routing can resolve a branch without a `Target branch:` or `Integration branch:` line in the issue body.
  WHY: With PR routing enabled, an issue lacking the required body metadata can pass the guard and proceed to planning; one reviewer classified this as NIT while the others classified it as MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:202-212 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The guard treats `resolver_status=resolved` as evidence that the issue body contains explicit target-branch metadata.
  WHY: PR routing can return a verified PR head branch without the required body line, allowing planning to proceed without the explicit metadata check.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1161-1164 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When label parsing fails and `resolver_status` is `none`, the guard reports that target-branch metadata is absent instead of that the check-triage label could not be verified.
  WHY: The operator may be told to add branch metadata even though unreadable labels caused the block.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1162-1164 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The blocked comment uses literal `<branch>` placeholders that GitHub Markdown can interpret as HTML tags and strip.
  WHY: The rendered instruction can omit the placeholder, leaving operators without a clear branch-name example.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1157-1158; agents.md:3190-3191 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The emitted `CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD` log prefix is not registered in the stable log-prefix registry.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting rely on registered prefixes; one reviewer classified this as NIT while another classified it as MAJOR.
- README.md:2385; changelog.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md:7-8 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The documentation says check-triage issues carry no branch line and will remain blocked until a separate change adds one, despite existing routing options that add branch metadata.
  WHY: Operators may incorrectly conclude the guard blocks all routed issues or be surprised that existing routing lets them pass.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add resolver and planning tests" (issue #7064).
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, in the plan-specific tests/static-checks workflow wiring
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `tests/test_plan_check_triage_branch_guard.py` is not referenced by any workflow; the CI test-wiring guard reports it as unwired and the static-checks run fails.
- requirement: Document behaviour in `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md`, not directly in `agents.md`.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The PR inserts documentation directly into `agents.md` at lines 363-368 (or 360-371); no matching `agents.d/7064-*.md` fragment is present, and the direct-edit check rejects the insertion.
- requirement: Stable log prefixes must be registered for workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md, with a block for the `Stable log prefixes (contractual)` section
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `plan.yml` emits `CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD`, but the stable log-prefix registry has no corresponding bullet or `LOG_PREFIX.name=CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD` entry.
- requirement: Accurate operator guidance for the new flag (README row and changelog fragment).
  expected_change_site: README.md `CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD_ENABLED` row and changelog.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Both documents claim triage issues have no branch line and will be blocked until a separate change adds one, without pointing operators to existing routing options that add `Target branch:` or `Integration branch:` metadata.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `resolved` status is treated as proof that the issue body has an explicit target-branch line, but PR-head routing can also produce that status.
  WHY: With both flags on, an issue with no branch line passes the guard as `metadata_present`; the log reason is misleading, though the branch comes from a verified PR head. The new test does not distinguish the cases.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When labels are unreadable and `resolver_status` is `none`, the guard message says there is no explicit target-branch metadata.
  WHY: The failure was reading labels, so the operator may be told to add a branch line that already exists.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `<branch>` placeholder in the posted GitHub comment can be treated as an unknown HTML tag.
  WHY: The rendered instruction can lose the placeholder and become less clear.
- agents.md (new log prefix registry) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD` is introduced without registration in the stable log-prefix registry or an `agents.d/` fragment.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting rely on registered prefixes, so these lines are not recognised.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Add resolver and planning tests" (issue #7064).
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. The step that runs `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py` is at line 1261 and is the natural place for it. The other plan tests sit there.
  Evidence of absence: A grep over `.github/workflows` for `test_plan_check_triage_branch_guard` returns nothing. The CI log shows `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py::test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow` failing with `tests/test_plan_check_triage_branch_guard.py` listed as unwired. The aggregate `lint` check therefore cannot pass, and the new tests never run in CI.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Document behaviour in `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md`, not in `agents.md`.
  Expected change site: `agents.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md`. It should start with a `<!-- agents: section="Workflow architecture" -->` marker and also carry the `Stable log prefixes (contractual)` block for the new prefix.
  Evidence of absence: The diff inserts 6 lines into `agents.md` at about lines 363-368 (hunk `@@ -360,6 +360,12 @@`) and replaces none. `scripts/check_agents_md_direct_edits.py` fails a pure insertion, and also anything over `AGENTS_MD_DIRECT_NET_ADD_MAX` (default 5). Both apply here. The agents.md direct-edit CI step would exit 1 once `static-checks` reaches it. No `agents.d/7064-*` file exists.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Accurate operator guidance for the new flag (README row and changelog fragment).
  Expected change site: the `CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD_ENABLED` README row and `changelog.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md`.
  Evidence of absence: Both say today's triage issues carry no branch line and the guard will block them "until a separate change adds that line". The same README table documents `CHECK_TRIAGE_PR_BRANCH_ROUTING_ENABLED`, which writes `Target branch: <head ref>`. It also documents `CHECK_TRIAGE_PR_HEAD_ROUTING_ENABLED` and `TRIAGE_PR_HEAD_BRANCH_METADATA_ENABLED`, which write an `Integration branch:` line. The docs do not point operators to these.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:202-212 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard treats `resolver_status=resolved` as evidence that the issue body contains explicit target-branch metadata.
  WHY: When CI-triage PR routing is enabled, the resolver can return a verified PR head branch without the explicit body line, allowing the issue to proceed to planning.
- agents.md:360-371 (in the stable log prefixes registry) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `CHECK_TRIAGE_BRANCH_GUARD`, emitted by `guard_log` in `plan.yml`, is not registered in the stable log-prefix registry.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting depend on this registry to handle the new log lines.

  Requirement: "Add resolver and planning tests." (CI wiring)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml (wire tests/test_plan_check_triage_branch_guard.py into static-checks or relevant test job)
  Evidence of absence: static-checks run fails because tests/test_plan_check_triage_branch_guard.py is not wired into any CI workflow step, so the test is never executed by the pipeline.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "agents.md fragments (CLAUDE.md §30): PRs document behaviour in agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md instead of editing this file."
  Expected change site: agents.d/7064-check-triage-branch-guard.md
  Evidence of absence: The PR directly edits agents.md at lines 360-371, failing the agents.md direct-edit CI check, and no agents.d/7064-*.md fragment accompanies the PR.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
